paragraphs.text: The Sun-Dappled Court is a topiary garden in Valeron on Bant , on the plane of Alara .

The Sun-Dappled Court is planted with thuja trees of immense size that are shaped to resemble the great steles scattered throughout the kingdoms. The Court contains the Twelve Trees of Valeron : immense, sculptured olive trees that each represent a particular noble bloodline, though all of the families of the court are considered to be one tribe. The families of the Sun-Dappled Court rule Valeron justly, though they have a defensive streak that can lead to diplomatic issues with other nations. trees that represent families. The Sword of Asha was buried under these trees before it was dug up and reforged. The trees were put back in the earth in their exact same spots, and still stand.
